messages:
Harper (AE): Client asks for SIG/CAIQ subset, LOA scoped to POC, and KMS options. Hosted vs Dedicated? Pricing delta?

Nina (Security): Hosted = Redwood keys; Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP); Private supports HSM. For vendor review we prefer Dedicated+BYOK.

Omar (Solutions): I can produce LOA one-pager, 8-question SIG subset in plain English, network diagram, and sample KMS snippet. ETA LOA+SIG = 1 business day, evidence bundle = 2 days.

Lena (SalesOps): POC pricing: Hosted = trial credits; Dedicated = daily trial rate (~$1,000/day) with setup waiver possible. BYOK -> Dedicated pricing.

Harper (AE): Customer Q: do logs include raw prompts by default? Also they want excluded controls noted in LOA.

Nina (Security): Default: metadata only; Hosted no full prompt retention unless enabled. LOA can explicitly exclude HR and company-wide retention.

evidence-bot: New evidence request EVID-7001 created. Assignee: Nina. Attachments: LOA_draft.docx, SIG_subset.csv.

Harper (AE): Great. I'll confirm BYOK and test dates with the customer and loop back. Thanks team :thumbsup:
